columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_id
columns.comment: The ID of the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_id
columns.comment: Output only. The ID of the ad group.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.comment: The ID of the campaign.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.comment: The ID of the customer.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_added_by_google_ads
columns.comment: Indicates if this ad was automatically added by Google Ads and not by a user. For example, this could happen when ads are automatically created as suggestions for new ads based on knowledge of how existing ads are performing.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_app_ad_descriptions
columns.comment: List of text assets for descriptions. When the ad serves the descriptions will be selected from this list.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_app_ad_headlines
columns.comment: List of text assets for headlines. When the ad serves the headlines will be selected from this list.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_app_ad_html5_media_bundles
columns.comment: List of media bundle assets that may be used with the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_app_ad_images
columns.comment: List of image assets that may be displayed with the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_app_ad_mandatory_ad_text
columns.comment: An optional text asset that, if specified, must always be displayed when the ad is served.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_app_ad_youtube_videos
columns.comment: List of YouTube video assets that may be displayed with the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_call_ad_phone_number
columns.comment: The phone number in the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_device_preference
columns.comment: The device preference for the ad. You can only specify a preference for mobile devices. When this preference is set the ad will be preferred over other ads when being displayed on a mobile device. The ad can still be displayed on other device types, e.g. if no other ads are available. If unspecified (no device preference), all devices are targeted. This is only supported by some ad types.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_display_url
columns.comment: The URL that appears in the ad description for some ad formats.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_expanded_dynamic_search_ad_description
columns.comment: The description of the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_expanded_dynamic_search_ad_description2
columns.comment: The second description of the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_expanded_text_ad_description
columns.comment: The description of the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_expanded_text_ad_description2
columns.comment: The second description of the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_expanded_text_ad_headline_part1
columns.comment: The first part of the ad's headline.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_expanded_text_ad_headline_part2
columns.comment: The second part of the ad's headline.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_expanded_text_ad_headline_part3
columns.comment: The third part of the ad's headline.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_expanded_text_ad_path1
columns.comment: The text that can appear alongside the ad's displayed URL.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_expanded_text_ad_path2
columns.comment: Additional text that can appear alongside the ad's displayed URL.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_final_app_urls
columns.comment: A list of final app URLs that will be used on mobile if the user has the specific app installed.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_final_mobile_urls
columns.comment: The list of possible final mobile URLs after all cross-domain redirects for the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_final_urls
columns.comment: The list of possible final URLs after all cross-domain redirects for the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_group
columns.comment: The ad group to which the ad belongs.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_image_ad_image_url
columns.comment: URL of the full size image.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_image_ad_mime_type
columns.comment: The mime type of the image.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_image_ad_name
columns.comment: The name of the image. If the image was created from a MediaFile, this is the MediaFile's name. If the image was created from bytes, this is empty.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_image_ad_pixel_height
columns.comment: Height in pixels of the full size image.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_image_ad_pixel_width
columns.comment: Width in pixels of the full size image.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_legacy_responsive_display_ad_accent_color
columns.comment: The accent color of the ad in hexadecimal, e.g. #ffffff for white. If one of main_color and accent_color is set, the other is required as well.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_legacy_responsive_display_ad_allow_flexible_color
columns.comment: Advertiser's consent to allow flexible color. When true, the ad may be served with different color if necessary. When false, the ad will be served with the specified colors or a neutral color. The default value is true. Must be true if main_color and accent_color are not set.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_legacy_responsive_display_ad_business_name
columns.comment: The business name in the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_legacy_responsive_display_ad_call_to_action_text
columns.comment: The call-to-action text for the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_legacy_responsive_display_ad_description
columns.comment: The description of the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_legacy_responsive_display_ad_format_setting
columns.comment: Specifies which format the ad will be served in. Default is ALL_FORMATS.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_legacy_responsive_display_ad_logo_image
columns.comment: The MediaFile resource name of the logo image used in the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_legacy_responsive_display_ad_long_headline
columns.comment: The long version of the ad's headline.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_legacy_responsive_display_ad_main_color
columns.comment: The main color of the ad in hexadecimal, e.g. #ffffff for white. If one of main_color and accent_color is set, the other is required as well.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_legacy_responsive_display_ad_marketing_image
columns.comment: The MediaFile resource name of the marketing image used in the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_legacy_responsive_display_ad_price_prefix
columns.comment: Prefix before price. E.g. 'as low as'.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_legacy_responsive_display_ad_promo_text
columns.comment: Promotion text used for dynamic formats of responsive ads. For example 'Free two-day shipping'.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_legacy_responsive_display_ad_short_headline
columns.comment: The short version of the ad's headline.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_legacy_responsive_display_ad_square_logo_image
columns.comment: The MediaFile resource name of the square logo image used in the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_legacy_responsive_display_ad_square_marketing_image
columns.comment: The MediaFile resource name of the square marketing image used in the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_name
columns.comment: Immutable. The name of the ad. This is only used to be able to identify the ad. It does not need to be unique and does not affect the served ad. The name field is currently only supported for DisplayUploadAd, ImageAd, ShoppingComparisonListingAd and VideoAd.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_display_ad_accent_color
columns.comment: The accent color of the ad in hexadecimal, e.g. #ffffff for white. If one of main_color and accent_color is set, the other is required as well.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_display_ad_business_name
columns.comment: The advertiser/brand name. Maximum display width is 25.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_display_ad_call_to_action_text
columns.comment: The call-to-action text for the ad. Maximum display width is 30.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_display_ad_descriptions
columns.comment: Descriptive texts for the ad. The maximum length is 90 characters. At least 1 and max 5 headlines can be specified.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_display_ad_format_setting
columns.comment: Specifies which format the ad will be served in. Default is ALL_FORMATS.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_display_ad_headlines
columns.comment: Short format headlines for the ad. The maximum length is 30 characters. At least 1 and max 5 headlines can be specified.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_display_ad_logo_images
columns.comment: Logo images to be used in the ad. Valid image types are GIF, JPEG, and PNG. The minimum size is 512x128 and the aspect ratio must be 4:1 (+-1%). Combined with square_logo_images the maximum is 5.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_display_ad_long_headline
columns.comment: A required long format headline. The maximum length is 90 characters.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_display_ad_main_color
columns.comment: The main color of the ad in hexadecimal, e.g. #ffffff for white. If one of main_color and accent_color is set, the other is required as well.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_display_ad_marketing_images
columns.comment: Marketing images to be used in the ad. Valid image types are GIF, JPEG, and PNG. The minimum size is 600x314 and the aspect ratio must be 1.91:1 (+-1%). At least one marketing_image is required. Combined with square_marketing_images the maximum is 15.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_display_ad_price_prefix
columns.comment: Prefix before price. E.g. 'as low as'.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_display_ad_promo_text
columns.comment: Promotion text used for dynamic formats of responsive ads. For example 'Free two-day shipping'.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_display_ad_square_logo_images
columns.comment: Square logo images to be used in the ad. Valid image types are GIF, JPEG, and PNG. The minimum size is 128x128 and the aspect ratio must be 1:1 (+-1%). Combined with square_logo_images the maximum is 5.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_display_ad_square_marketing_images
columns.comment: Square marketing images to be used in the ad. Valid image types are GIF, JPEG, and PNG. The minimum size is 300x300 and the aspect ratio must be 1:1 (+-1%). At least one square marketing_image is required. Combined with marketing_images the maximum is 15.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_display_ad_youtube_videos
columns.comment: Optional YouTube videos for the ad. A maximum of 5 videos can be specified.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_search_ad_descriptions
columns.comment: List of text assets for descriptions. When the ad serves the descriptions will be selected from this list.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_search_ad_headlines
columns.comment: List of text assets for headlines. When the ad serves the headlines will be selected from this list.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_search_ad_path1
columns.comment: First part of text that may appear appended to the url displayed in the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_responsive_search_ad_path2
columns.comment: Second part of text that may appear appended to the url displayed in the ad. This field can only be set when path1 is also set.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_strength
columns.comment: Overall ad strength for this ad group ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_system_managed_resource_source
columns.comment: If this ad is system managed, then this field will indicate the source. This field is read-only.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_text_ad_description1
columns.comment: The first line of the ad's description.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_text_ad_description2
columns.comment: The second line of the ad's description.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_text_ad_headline
columns.comment: The headline of the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_tracking_url_template
columns.comment: The URL template for constructing a tracking URL.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_type
columns.comment: The type of ad.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_ad_url_custom_parameters
columns.comment: The list of mappings that can be used to substitute custom parameter tags in a `tracking_url_template`, `final_urls`, or `mobile_final_urls`. For mutates, please use url custom parameter operations.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_policy_summary_approval_status
columns.comment: Output only. The overall approval status of this ad, calculated based on the status of its individual policy topic entries.

columns.name: ad_group_ad_status
columns.comment: The status of the ad.
